topic: the Pig War of 1859 -- a US-Britain border standoff whose only casualty was a pig
title: The Only War in History Where the Sole Casualty Was a Pig
description: AI-narrated commentary on the Pig War of 1859 -- a real US-Britain border standoff over the San Juan Islands that lasted 13 years and killed exactly one pig.

hook_candidates.text: The only war in American history where the single casualty was a pig.
What if the strangest border dispute in American history started with a single dead pig?
You'd think a real war needs real casualties, but this one only had a pig's.
In June 1859, an American farmer shot a British company's prize pig, and a war nearly followed.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who insists every war has to be dramatic and bloody, just to watch them lose it over a pig.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume a war can only have a soldier as its casualty, never a farm animal like a pig.
closing_comment: The pig at the center of this whole war never even got a name in the official record. Anyone else never learn about this one in school?

sources.note: Confirms the 1859 San Juan Island standoff started with a shot pig and ran until 1872.
